Nora (PM): Quick sync 1: competitor rolled out a budget edge tier targeting prototyping teams. They're advertising $0.0006/token and a simple SDK. We need a playbook: fast parity promo vs double-down on our specialty (predictable QoS + routing). Inputs?

Dev (Runtime Eng): Parity is doable but with trade-offs: fewer concurrent sessions per GPU, higher infra $/token. Two engineering paths: (A) optimized low-latency profile (smaller batches, aggressive preemption) or (B) quantized micro-model to hit cost targets. (A) quicker, (B) better cost long-term.

Leo (ML): Micro-models need careful eval. For embeddings or short-chat we can quantize aggressively. For multi-turn assistants we risk hallucinations. Need concrete eval thresholds.

Jen (Sales): We're losing inbound trials asking for cheaper options. If we offer a time-limited promo, we can capture churners and upsell to dedicated later. Prefer promo gated by use-case (single-turn chat, embeddings).

Omar (GTM): Suggest 90-day pilot with clear limits: requests/min, max tokens/session, and telemetry access. Messaging: "prototype-tier backed by Redwood reliability". Avoid outright price matching; present as limited pilot.

Ravi (SRE): Ops constraints: autopruning of idle KV caches, stronger routing fallback, and a canary rollout required. Need an automated rollback trigger if error-rate > 2% or latency p95 > 350ms for 30m.

Maya (Design): UI idea: a compact plan selector in Console that shows expected latency/cost range and a badge for "pilot". Also micro-copy to explain limitations (no private deploys). I'll sketch.

Nora (PM): Let's define measurable launch criteria before dev work:
- Perf: p95 <= 200ms for seq<=64 on the low-latency profile
- Cost: delivered cost per 1k tokens <= $0.9 of competitor baseline in our test cluster (after infra amortization)
- Quality: automated evals: BLEU/ROUGE not falling more than 4% for summarization, and human QA failure rate <= 2% on sample prompts
- Safety: no regression on our safety filters; must pass intent checks
- Ops: automated rollback rules configured; canary to 5% of traffic for 48h
- GTM: pilot signup page + T&Cs ready

Dev (Runtime Eng): OK. I'll scope a 10-day spike for the low-latency profile + basic quantization experiment. Deliverables: perf dashboard, infra cost model, rollback playbook.

Leo (ML): I'll prepare an eval matrix (chat, summarization, extraction, embeddings) and run baseline vs quantized model. ETA 4d.

Jen (Sales): I'll compile a list of 10 outbound targets who signalled price risk. Need landing page copy and pilot terms.

Omar (GTM): I'll draft the pilot offer and email template. Also thinking of a "redeemable credit" approach instead of permanent price cuts. Keeps economics sane.

Ravi (SRE): For the canary we'll need a circuit-breaker that moves traffic off the profile if p95 spikes or infrastructure OOMs. I'll add metrics/alerts to the runbook.

Maya (Design): Mocking plan selector + "pilot" badge. Will include a tooltip that says: 'Pilot tier: cost-optimized for lightweight flows. Not recommended for long-form generation.'

ci-bot: CI pipeline: created branch feat/edge-proto-1787654321 and scheduled nightly perf job.

Nora (PM): Decision: run the 10-day engineering spike aligned to the launch criteria. If we meet perf + cost thresholds, we launch a 90-day pilot limited to single-turn/chat and embeddings with strict usage caps. If not, pivot to a GTM play focused on our strengths: consistent SLAs, private deployments, and model routing for quality.

Dev (Runtime Eng): Starting spike now. Will post initial perf runs and cost breakdown in this thread.

Leo (ML): Baseline eval running now; will upload results and a CSV of prompts for review.

Jen (Sales): I'll prepare messaging to offer pilot slots conditioned on a credit card + signed pilot MSA.

Omar (GTM): We'll also prepare a short FAQ explaining why some workloads are not eligible (e.g., long-form summarization).

Ravi (SRE): Noted. I'll create alerts and an emergency rollback playbook in runbook/doc.

Maya (Design): Uploading early mocks: /files/pilot-selector-v1.png. Feedback welcome.

Nora (PM): Final: sync in 10 days for spike review. If anyone finds a blocker (safety, infra, or legal), ping #lead-product immediately and hold the promo. Thanks.
